reserves.issuerOrObligor: Wrapped Bitcoin custodians and merchant network

reserveReview.rationale: The configured BTCFi producer reports the current collateral mix by supported handler. Native BTC is direct crypto collateral, while BTCB, cbBTC, and WBTC retain their wrapper issuer, custody, counterparty, and smart-contract failure domains.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: BTCFi current collateral balances by supported handler, refreshed 2026-08-09 from the BTCFi market API (deposit_value BTC 3,870,695.66 / BTCB 2,881,579.40 / cbBTC 74,635.15 / WBTC 4,702.87 of the $6,831,613.08 covered by the supported-handler registry) and normalized over the handlers the producer can see
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The four handlers above are the full set the BTCFi supported-handler API publishes (ids 0-4, of which id 2 is the BtcUSD borrow side), and their wrapper custody and redemption risks remain explicit structured risk factors. On 2026-08-09 the BTCFi market API additionally returned a handler id 5 holding 133,780,914.2 units worth $847,661.29 (about 11% of true collateral, priced at 0.00633619 and identified on-chain as a JPYC collateral handler on Bifrost) that the supported-handler registry omits this handler, so the producer cannot see it and the composition above does not represent it. The structured pct stays 0 because the schema ties unresolved dispositions to visible reserve slices; re-raise it when the producer registers handler 5 and the slice exists.
